title: HERMES：基于临床笔记的对比感知知识图谱推理用于患者预后预测
summary: HERMES是一个仅基于临床文本的图框架，通过LLM引导从临床笔记中构建个性化知识图谱，并用对比逻辑建模捕捉时序动态与治疗失败，再以图注意力网络生成患者表征。在MIMIC-III/IV的院内死亡率和30天再入院预测上优于纯文本基线。
summary_en: HERMES is a graph-based framework operating solely on clinical text. It builds personalized knowledge graphs via LLM-guided extraction from clinical notes with Contrastive Logic Modeling to capture temporal dynamics and treatment failures, then uses a Graph Attention Network to synthesize patient representations. It outperforms strong text-only baselines on MIMIC-III/IV for in-hospital mortality and 30-day readmission prediction.
